blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National University-Archipelago Builders swept Alpha Insurance, 25-20, 25-20, 25-23, to stay unscathed in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Thursday at Mall of Asia Arena. Obed Mukaba delivered seven blocks to finish with eight points as the Bulldogs tied defending champion Criss Cross, Far Eastern University-DN Steel, and ClearSkiiin with identical 2-0 cards.
